chunks: If someone does so through oppression or injustice, We shall cast him into Hell: This is how (the Law of) God works inevitably.

key_terms.عُدْوَانًا: Aggression or acting out of hostility
key_terms.فَسَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِ: Then We shall cause him to enter/cast him into

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of committing a sin with oppression and injustice according to Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the gravity of *'udwan* (aggression) and *zulm* (injustice) as the dual pillars of major sins, particularly highlighting the transition from temporal punishment to eternal abode in Hellfire. The phrase 'easy for Allah' (*yaseeran*) serves to reassure believers of the certainty of divine justice, affirming that while retribution is inevitable, it is not burdensome to the Almighty, thereby encouraging repentance before the final reckoning.
